result.brief: 提出 ScaleDrive：仅用大规模无动作驾驶视频做视频潜空间预测预训练，冻结编码器后验证表征在端到端规划中的可迁移性，并系统研究规模化规律。
result.reason: Action-free video latent prediction pretraining yields transferable spatiotemporal visual representations, probed for ego-motion and depth; representation contribution, with driving planning as downstream application.
